sre-bot: INCIDENT PAGE: [P2] inference-pool-usw node gcu-node-14 transitioned to NotReady (kubelet restart) ~5m ago. Affected: inference-runtime-* pods (3/12 crashlooping). Symptoms: spike in 5xx and 99th latency. Pager -> maria (oncall).

maria (oncall): acked. i'm on it — pinging infra and ml. can someone post recent kubelet logs / dmesg if available?

ashok: seen this pattern before. dmesg on gcu-node-14 shows repeated GPU driver faults + oomkiller churn. snippet:

```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (0001:0): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 12345.679002] nvidia: GPU 0000:3b:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 12345.679100] kubelet: E0722 12:34:56.789012   1234 eviction_manager.go:117] eviction manager: failed to oomkill pod "inference-runtime-7d8f9" - no pages to free
[ 12345.679201] Out of memory: Kill process 20456 (inference-srv) score 987 or sacrifice child
[ 12345.679302] kernel: oom_reaper: reaped process 20456 (inference-srv), now anon-rss:0kB, file-rss:0kB
```

ashok: the gpu 'fell off the bus' usually points to driver/firmware or a transient PCI error. also seeing CUDA Error: out of memory in container logs which aligns with runtime trying to allocate large KV caches.

jake (infra): if node is unstable we should cordon + drain and restart kubelet. can we move pods off before they hit fewer healthy nodes? i'll stand by to reboot if needed. commands:

```
kubectl cordon gcu-node-14
kubectl drain gcu-node-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
systemctl restart kubelet
# if node unresponsive: ssh and sudo reboot
```

maria (oncall): running cordon/drain now. draining showed 2 pods stuck in Terminating with SIGKILL loops. grabbing logs from one of the inference containers:

```
2026-07-22T12:31:02Z inference-srv[pid=20456]: ERROR runtime: CUDA Error: out of memory when allocating 512MB for KV cache
2026-07-22T12:31:03Z inference-srv[pid=20456]: WARN: attempting to fallback to quantized model variant
2026-07-22T12:31:03Z containerd: io.containerd.runtime.v2.task: exit status 137
```

maria (oncall): noting that the runtime attempted fallback but process OOM'd and container restarted, so fallback didn't mitigate. marking this node as suspect in routing so control plane avoids it while we triage. sending temp routing override.

deploy-bot: FYI - there was a driver rollout to nvidia-driver:v530 in usw-2 starting ~2h ago. gcu-node-14 shows the new driver installed ~30m before the first alerts.

jake (infra): ok that's actionable. possible regression in v530 with our kernel (5.15.x) on this machine. i'll reboot and revert driver on that node if kernel logs confirm. continuing: please scale up inference-pool in the short term to reduce pressure on remaining nodes.

ashok: scaling suggestion: bump to +2 replicas for the pool and evict heavy KV-cache pods first. command:

```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/inference-pool --replicas=14
kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-pool
```

tara (support): incoming CX notes: two customers (alpha-integrations, chat-prd) reported intermittent 5xx between 12:30-12:40 UTC. we've posted the status update to status.redwood.ai and told them we're mitigating. no data exposure reported, this is service availability only.

maria (oncall): routing override applied: control-plane rule set to avoid nodes labelled 'suspect=true' in usw-2. that dropped error-rate by ~40% within 2m. still seeing elevated latencies for long-context requests.

jake (infra): node rebooted and kubelet restarted. after reboot we see kernel PCIe reset logs cleared; but driver load shows some WARNs. plan: continue to keep node cordoned, revert driver to v525 on that node, run soak tests. i'll coordinate with deploy team to pause further v530 rollouts until postmortem.

maria (oncall): confirming drain completed for most pods; 2 small jobs were restarted on other nodes. scaling executed and rollout completed. error-rate back to baseline for short prompts; long context heavy requests still have a few 5xx due to transient queueing.

ashok: note for postmortem: try reducing KV cache prefetch on the runtime for this pool (config param: max_kv_prefetch_mb) as a short-term config mitigation; that reduces per-instance memory pressure.

maria (oncall): handing off to jake (infra) for driver reversion + kernel/firmware follow-up. i'll stay on until node is marked Ready and uncordoned. incident ticket created: INC-2026-1347.

jake (infra): acknowledged. i'll do driver rollback and kernel msg capture, then schedule a small canary test (1 node) before v530 resumes. will post timeline in the ticket.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-1347 created and assigned to infra. Priority: P2. Runbook: Kubernetes node instability -> follow cordon/drain/reboot/driver-rollback.

maria (oncall): summary: cause hypothesis = new nvidia-driver v530 interacting poorly with kernel/PCIe on a subset of hosts leading to GPU drop and OOMs. mitigation steps taken: cordon+drain node, scale up pool, routing override, reboot node, created incident ticket. next: driver rollback + soak tests, runtime config tuning (kv prefetch) as temporary safeguard, postmortem in 48h. handing to infra. :white_check_mark:

tara (support): sending final OK to customers who asked for update. good work team. :thumbsup:
